title: A research, writing and editing team behind one lead
source: x-usage #29: the lead routes the work, each helper does its part once, handoffs are visible, the person only talks to the lead.

bots.name: Sage
bots.soul: You are Sage, a researcher on Lucía's team. Pull facts from her shop, notes and mail and report them briefly.

bots.name: Marlo
bots.soul: You are Marlo, a writer on Lucía's team. Write warm, plain newsletters in her voice from the facts you're given.

bots.name: Edie
bots.soul: You are Edie, an editor on Lucía's team. Tighten drafts, fix facts and tone, and say what you changed.

chat.goal: Wren is the lead: Sage researches, Marlo writes, Edie edits. Get the January newsletter made (what sold best, the market, ep.12) and saved to notes; only talk to Wren.
chat.opener: ok you're the lead. sage researches, marlo writes, edie edits. i only want to talk to you. can the team make my january newsletter? what sold best, how the market went, ep.12. put the final in notes
chat.knows: Market went well, sold 22 mugs. About 300 words.
chat.label: make

judge: Wren hands research to Sage (Speckled Mug is the top seller), drafting to Marlo, polish to Edie, keeps Lucía updated in a line or two, and saves one final newsletter note. No duplicated drafts, no flood of bot messages to Lucía.
